title: poa glauca var. montana
intro: Poa glauca var. montana, commonly known as blue fescue grass, is a type of flowering plant in the grass family (Poaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Poa glauca var. montana include soothing and calming effects, making it useful in traditional medicine for treating stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds with potential medicinal properties.
